basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in San Francisco's desirable Outer Parkside neighborhood. The interior features refinished original hardwood floors in the bedrooms, abundant natural light, and skylights that create a warm and open atmosphere. The functional layout includes a versatile bonus room with kitchenette, perfect for a home office, gym, playroom, or guest suite. A 1-car garage provides convenient parking and inside washer and dryer. Step outside to a charming backyard with a covered patio and low-maintenance succulent garden, ideal for relaxing or entertaining year-round. Ideally nestled between the SF Zoo, Golden Gate Park, and Ocean Beach, this home has easy access to recreation, top-rated schools, shopping, dining, and public transportation.  Whether you're taking a morning jog along the shore, exploring nearby trails, or visiting neighborhood cafes, this home offers the perfect blend of coastal charm and city convenience.
